answer: Sybil resistance combines EigenTrust matrix factorization, temporal decay, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity: reputation has an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to accumulate durable weight. A freshly spawned sybil starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality; isolated from trusted paths, it cannot pass consensus, even if it forms an island, adopts a juniper alias, or emits a coordinated signal.
